all.description: Every canonical skill. Largest context footprint; the router still loads only one primary skill (plus at most one companion) per task.

minimal.description: Evergreen guardrails only. Smallest install for vibe coders who want safety without stack knowledge.

fullstack.description: Guardrails plus testing, backend/API, database, and debugging skills for typical web and app repos.

frontend.description: Fullstack plus frontend engineering, visuals/3D, and design-taste discovery for projects with a UI layer.

security-focused.description: Guardrails plus application security for projects where secrets, auth, or data protection dominate.
